newsitem.title: UK: FKI to look for more acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: FKI to look for more acquisitions.

text.p: Diversified UK engineering company FKI Plc is expected to continue with its investments in new capital equipment and further acquisitions in the second half of its current financial year, its chairman said on Wednesday. "Our strategy of investment in new capital eqquipment, new product development and further acquisitions will continue to be our focus and I am therefore confident of another successful year," chairman Jeff Whalley forecast.
On Wednesday, FKI announced a 35 percent hike in its pre-tax profit to 51.4 million stg and mooted an interim dividend of 3.1 pence for the first six months to Septermber 30.

FKI's share price held firm as it traded in the 200-206p range, up from its overnight close of 198.5p. Whalley said the firm's strategy to invest in modern equipment had helped it cut costs. Acquisitions had helped it raise its market share and it would contiinue to do so, he said.

The company acquired Wright Products last July, which had strengthened its hardware group's market position.It also recently acquired Marelli Motori and the Hawker Siddeley Electric Power Group for 235 million stg. "These provide excellent opportunities for our engineering group to grow future profits," Whalley said. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
